newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Expected good results lift Casablanca exchange.
newsitem.headline: Expected good results lift Casablanca exchange.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed on Monday 0.41 percent higher with some stocks rising on talk of good results, brokers said.
The all-share index closed at 468.20 points from 466.28 on Friday.
"Some stocks rose following rumours of better than expected profits," Mohamed Mekouar at Upline Securities said.
ONA group, the country's largest conglomerate, and Wafabank, remained unchanged at 570 dirhams each.
In the banking sector, Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur shed one dirham to close at 429 dirhams while Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie was up five dirhams to 346 dirhams.
Credit du Maroc which last traded on Jan 6 at 336 dirhams, was up 14 dirhams to 350 dirhams.
Credit firm Eqdom Credit, which said on Thursday it had increased it capital by more than 50.3 percent to 167.02 million dirhams ($18.9 million), was up 26 dirhams to close at 909 dirhams.
Another good performer was brewery firm, Brasseries du Maroc which gained 45 dirhams to 1595 dirhams.
Samir refinery took two dirhams to close at 235 dirhams after a week's decline.
Traded volume on the official market was 25.5 million from 25.6 million dirhams on Friday.
